questions: Should the function count characters, bytes, or grapheme clusters (e.g., emoji with skin tone modifiers)?
Does 'size' refer to the memory footprint (in bytes) of the string object?
Should the function handle None input by raising an error or returning something else?
Is the function expected to strip whitespace or ignore certain characters before counting?
Should the function count newline characters as one or two characters (CRLF vs LF)?
Does 'size' include the null terminator as in C-style strings?
Is the function required to handle strings containing escape sequences (like '\n') as one character or multiple?
Should the function return the length of the string's representation (e.g., repr) instead of the string itself?
